get.description: Returns a list of projects, each including its weekly tasks, tasks with their sub-tasks (steps) and goals. By default only projects with ACTIVE or IN_PROGRESS status are returned; pass statuses to override the included statuses and sortByPriority=true to sort by priority (HIGH, MIDDLE, LOW, then by name)

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Project statuses to include in the response. Default: ACTIVE,IN_PROGRESS (inactive projects are excluded)

parameters.name: sortByPriority
parameters.description: Sort projects by priority: HIGH, MIDDLE, LOW, then by name ascending
